item.title: M90 Scotstoun (Northbound)
item.description:
🔴 Major traffic restrictions
• The northbound carriageway between M9 Junction 1A Scoutsoun and M90 Junction 1A Queensferry crossing is currently closed due to planned roadworks. To facilitate this all on and off slips between these junctions are also closed.
Updated: 20:08
